toyData: All sample counts, identities, timing, proportions and area geometry invented; not Diana data or thresholds
altText: Equal invented 1 mL plasma aliquots each contain four tumor-attributed molecule symbols. A has 16 background symbols and 20 total; B has 36 background symbols and 40 total. Four molecules per mL stays equal while the recovered-molecule share drops from 4/20, or 20%, to 4/40, or 10%. These toy molecule shares are not automatically variant allele fraction, an assay-estimated tumor fraction or MTM/mL; those quantities require their stated method and model.
caption: Equal invented volumes retain four tumor-attributed molecules each, so concentration stays constant while added background halves this toy molecule fraction.
